objective_vision_observations: A yellow background page with the title text 'A FEW FRIENDS AND FAMILY' at the top and bottom. The page contains 10 photographs arranged loosely in an oval shape with decorated corners on some. Two cut-out images of dogs are placed at the top left and right corners of the page. Most photographs depict people in various settings including dining, outdoors, and social gatherings. Several faces and parts of the images are blacked out for privacy. The photographs vary between color and black and white.
